arrival.speaker: Mayor Shen
arrival.say: Welcome to Festival City. Our brightest celebration has become a contest of pride, and old arguments now stalk the streets.

arrival.speaker: Mayor Shen
arrival.say: The Grudge Dragon grows stronger whenever people refuse to listen. Help the city remember how to celebrate together.

reform.speaker: Grudge Dragon
reform.say: I kept every insult polished like treasure. Each old grievance became another scale on my back.

reform.speaker: Mayor Shen
reform.say: Harmony does not erase disagreement. It begins when we listen, repair what was hurt, and move forward together.

reform.speaker: Spirit Brush
reform.say: Harmony Stroke restored. The hidden Harmony Pavilion can now be opened.
